title: Majority mean depends on coalition size
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be sets of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube with equal cardinality, and let $b$ be a sign. The means of majority after replacing the coordinates in $A$ by $b$ and after replacing the coordinates in $B$ by $b$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are finite sets of coordinates
